expected_level_description: You can: - set the organisation's learning strategy and standards - lead the learning offer, its technology, and its funding - show the return on the organisation's investment in learning

You can: - run skills gap analysis for a team or profession and report the results - design career pathways and development routes using framework levels - use framework skills to write consistent job descriptions and assessments

You can: - diagnose organisational issues and design interventions to address them - lead team development, leadership development, and engagement programmes - evaluate the effect of interventions using evidence

You can: - write and lead people plans for a directorate in line with the people strategy - advise senior leaders on people risks and priorities - lead part of the HR function, setting its standards and priorities

skill: Capability building for digital, data and technology
expected_level_description: *Senior leadership skill: the UK GDaD PCF defines it with one statement, not by level.* You can: - guide the organisation to ensure it has the specialist digital, data and technology skills it needs - develop organisational processes and ways of working so that digital and data roles you support can thrive - continuously improve and optimise the organisational environment Examples of leadership using this skill: - prioritising capability needs that will have the most impact - negotiating for longer-term investment in people by articulating the risks and benefits of different staffing strategies - advocating for good practice in ways of working and supporting people to adopt this practice - growing digital and data communities

You can: - make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase - build consensus between services or independent stakeholders - identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them - engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick - bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in - facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - hold and manage a budget, forecasting and explaining variances - build a business case with costs and benefits
You can: - carry out equality impact assessments - build inclusive teams and practices
